name: stripe
description: Stripe billing data and write access — subscriptions, invoices, usage meters, customers, analytics

requirements: Stripe account (use a sandbox for tests)
Agent API key from the Dashboard (Agent badge) or OAuth sign-in
Restricted permissions matching the tools the skills bind
notes: Stripe hosts the MCP server remotely at https://mcp.stripe.com (streamable HTTP).
The local npm packages @stripe/mcp and @stripe/agent-toolkit were deprecated on 2026-11-04 and receive no further security fixes.
From 2027-01-11 Stripe MCP stops accepting full-access secret keys and non-agent restricted keys; use an agent API key or OAuth.
